messages:
kevin: Quick sync following the postmortem.
We need owners, milestone dates, and precise SLO copy to publish a temporary amendment for text-gen (latency + throughput).

yasmin: I'll own the SLO copy and customer blurb. Draft proposal: p99 <= 300ms (30-day rolling) and throughput p95 >= 100 qps per shard during peak hours. Temporary for 21 days. Will add rollback criteria.

oliver: I'll take dashboards/alerts. Plan: add per-route p50/p90/p99, shard qps panels, and a 7-day error-budget burn. Can push dashboard JSON within 48h and add a synthetic check.

dina: I'll own runtime mitigations: short-term batching tweaks + fallback routing. Short-term PRs: batching in 10 days, fallback in 5 days. Need a dev GPU for profiling.

kevin: Rollback triggers proposed: auto rollback if error-budget burn > 25% in 24h OR p99 > 600ms for >10m. Also require dashboards + rollback automation in prod before we publish temporary SLO.

yasmin: Adding public-facing sentence: "Temporary SLO amendment: text-gen p99 target 300ms (30-day rolling) and throughput p95 >= 100 qps/shard during peak; subject to rollback on sustained degradation. See SRE ticket for details." Will post draft to ticket.

incident-bot: Created ticket SRE-8234: "pm/followup/slo-amendment-text-gen" and populated checklist with owners.

oliver: Draft PromQL for p99 spike (5m eval):
```
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{route="text-gen"}[5m])) by (le)) > 0.30
```
And error-budget burn (1h):
```
(sum(increase(requests_total{route="text-gen",status!~"5.."}[1h])) / sum(increase(requests_total{route="text-gen"}[1h]))) < 0.98
```
Will tune thresholds after staging.

dina: Milestones to add to SRE-8234: dashboards+alerts by 2034568700 (48h), fallback PR by 2034590000 (5 days), batching PR opened by 2035170000 (10 days), public SLO publish gated on prod checks by 2035200000 (14 days).

kevin: Thanks. Final ask: update SRE-8234 with explicit rollback steps and the exact signals that count as SLA violations. I'll approve the temporary SLO once dashboards and automation are verified. :white_check_mark:
